[[Raid on Shing Jea Monastery (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Raid on Shing Jea Monastery map.jpg|250px]] | map1text = Location of gates and Interim Headmaster Mhenlo }} Stave off the [[Sensali]] [[Tengu]] assault on the [[Shing Jea Monastery|Monastery]] and defend [[Mhenlo]] with your life. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Speak with [[Qao Lin]] when you are ready for combat. * Position the [[Imperial Guard]]s in defensive positions and utilize your [[Improvised Fire Bomb (bundle)|Improvised Fire Bombs]]. There is only a short time before they breach the gates! * Defeat the attacking Tengu. * Interim Headmaster Mhenlo must survive. * See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward. ===Reward=== * 5,000 [[Experience]] * 2,000 [[Gold]] * [[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] * Imperial Guard Requisition Order * Imperial Guard Requisition Order == Walkthrough == The Tengu will enter through two gates: first through the main gate (near where the profession trainers stand normally) and later through the north gate (i.e. the [[Sunqua Vale]] portal); fortunately, they do not come through [[Linnok Courtyard]], so you only have to defend from two directions. Your best bet is to defend Mhenlo where he stands, since your primary goal is to prevent his death and it is nearly impossible to defend both gates. You have about 30 seconds before your opponents start attacking the gates and perhaps another 30 seconds before they can make their way to Mhenlo. Once the Tengu start to swarm, their Necromancers will use [[Aura of the Lich]] to create massive minion armies and their Mesmers will use [[Panic]]. There are no healers (and almost no hex removal). Should you wipe, the party will resurrect near Mhenlo's original location, although this usually leads to quest failure because he will be left unprotected. ===Options=== You have two additional types of help available during this quest: * [[Apprentice Zhi]] will make [[Improvised Fire Bomb (bundle)|explosives]] that can be used as [[Improvised Fire Bomb]]s or 90 second-duration [[Improvised Fire Trap]]s (''IFTs''). These skills can be obtained approximately every 10 seconds. Once you use one of the two explosive skills your skillbars resets back to normal and each skill must recharge before it can be used again. ** Take note that should Apprentice Zhi die, she does not resurrect, unlike the Canthan Guards. ** For quick access, you can accept multiple bombs from Zhi, then drop the Improvised Fire Bomb bundle on the ground without using it up. * You can move the [[Canthan Guard]]s to better positions. Talk to them once to get them to follow you; speak to them again to get them to remain where they are. ===Tactics=== ;Tactic #1 First, place the guards to make good use of the natural choke points by having them [[body block]] the two stairways leading to Mhenlo; make sure these guards are positioned within earshot of a healer NPC. Then, drop as many ''IFT''s as you can along the paths. Spread out any heroes and pop any defensive [[spirit]]s they might have available before the Tengu arrive. During the battle, you can keep grabbing explosives and tossing them at the balled-up foes. ;Tactic #2 An aggressive style of playing is to fight at an archway just west of Mhenlo's location. Aggro incoming mobs to fight your party there, so they don't reach Mhenlo. Should you party wipe, there will be time for your party to get resurrected. ;Tactic #3 If you have a minion master, watch out for Mhenlo following your minions around as he tries to keep them healed. In fact, if you flag your team at the Linnok Courtyard gate beyond the portal, both Quin AND Mhenlo will follow the minions there. If you kill your minions, Mhenlo and Quin will stay stationary near the gate, allowing you to more easily deal with the Sensali at your pace. === Recommended skills === * [[Area of effect]] damage skills. * AoE protection and healing skills (so that your [[List of skills which affects allies|allies benefit]]), especially [[Recuperation]], [[Shelter]] and/or [[Union]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Gate]]s *{{w}} 30 [[Divine Ward]] *{{w}} 30 [[Front Gate]] [[Human]]s *{{w}}{{e}} 20 [[Canthan Guard]] *{{w}}{{a}} 20 Canthan Guard *{{w}}{{rt}} 20 Canthan Guard *{{w}} 20 [[Canthan Peasant]] *{{w}} 20 [[Monastery Student]] *{{w}} 20 [[Headmaster Zhan]] *{{r}} 20 [[Canthan Guard]] *{{r}} 20 Canthan Peasant *{{r}} 20 Monastery Student *{{r}} 20 [[Headmaster Greico]] *{{mo}} 20 [[Apprentice Zhi]] *{{mo}} 20 [[Headmaster Amara]] *{{mo}} 20 [[Mhenlo|Interim Headmaster Mhenlo]] *{{mo}} 20 Canthan Peasant *{{mo}} 20 Monastery Student *{{n}} 20 [[Headmaster Kuju]] *{{me}} 20 [[Headmaster Kaa]] *{{e}} 20 [[Headmaster Vhang]] *{{a}} 20 Canthan Peasant *{{a}} 20 Monastery Student *{{a}} 20 [[Headmaster Lee]] *{{rt}} 20 [[Headmaster Quin]] ===Foes=== [[Tengu]] ([[Sensali]]) *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Sensali Warrior]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Sensali Ranger]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Sensali Necromancer]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Sensali Mesmer]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Sensali Elementalist]] *{{a}} 24 (26) [[Sensali Assassin]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"I knew we could count on you to volunteer, but we are short on time. They thought the Sensali had lost the will to fight, but that's exactly what the clever birds wanted us to believe. The Sensali have already surrounded the monastery, and it's only a matter of time before they break through the gates. The Ministry is nowhere to be found, and we're the only ones close enough to reach Shing Jea in time. Say the word and we'll depart."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = Those Tengu don't realize they were attacking the school of hard knocks to their heads! | decline = I've never really been a fan of education anyway... | ask = Are you ready to set sail? }} :::{{yes|ingame}}'''"Raise the anchors!"''' :::{{no|ingame}}'''"I've never really been a fan of education anyway..."''' ===Intermediate dialogue=== :'''Interim Headmaster Mhenlo:''' ''"Thank [[Gods of Tyria|The Six]] you have arrived! Perhaps if I speak with them on your behalf. I could speak with [[Reiko]]..."'' :''':''' ''"I thank you for the offer, but I think it's due time I speak with her myself."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"Well done, . You defended the monastery and, perhaps more importantly, greatly weakened the Sensali. This was a desperation move, and their numbers will be greatly depleted by it. Of course, that hasn't stopped the Ministry of Purity from using this attack to propose a new law banning ALL Tengu from Cantha. I wouldn't be surprised to learn that the reason they were not there to defend the monastery was because they wanted it to fall to the Tengu, just so they could point to that to pass their hateful law! But I digress. This was a great victory, and you have our thanks. I would say you should stay and celebrate, but I believe [[Miku|our mutual friend]] would like to speak with you in [[Shenzun Tunnels]]."'' ==Notes== * After using one of the explosive skills or dropping the bundle, all of your skills begin recharging for their normal recharge times.
